description: This file implements a scheduler policy for time-based QoS in a wireless communication system, including classes and functions for managing UE history, rate estimation, and priority computation based on QoS metrics.

classes.name: ue_history_repository
classes.description: Manages UE history data including average rates and grants.

classes.name: rate_estimator
classes.description: Estimates maximum downlink and uplink transport block sizes based on channel conditions.

classes.name: scheduler_time_qos
classes.description: Implements a time-based QoS scheduler for UE prioritization in uplink and downlink.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the history repository.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the history repository.

methods.name: save_dl_newtx_grants
methods.description: Stores downlink grants in UE history for rate calculation.

methods.name: save_ul_newtx_grants
methods.description: Stores uplink grants in UE history for rate calculation.

methods.name: estimate_max_dl_tbs
methods.description: Estimates maximum downlink transport block size for a UE.

methods.name: estimate_max_ul_tbs
methods.description: Estimates maximum uplink transport block size for a UE.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the scheduler.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the scheduler.

methods.name: compute_ue_dl_priorities
methods.description: Computes downlink priorities for UEs based on QoS metrics.

methods.name: compute_ue_ul_priorities
methods.description: Computes uplink priorities for UEs based on QoS metrics.

methods.name: compute_dl_prio
methods.description: Calculates downlink priority for a UE.

methods.name: compute_ul_prio
methods.description: Calculates uplink priority for a UE.
